name: Luxury Noir Gold
tagline: Near-black stage with champagne-gold hairlines, italic Playfair headlines and diamond ornaments, like a perfume house invitation (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: noir black with cream text and a gold gradient accent

typography.style: high-contrast italic serif headlines with widely tracked uppercase sans labels

best_for: Luxury, fashion, fragrance, jewelry and premium hospitality stories that should feel unhurried and exclusive. Works for any short, image-light talk that wants ceremony.
avoid_for: Data-dense reports and technical talks that need small text and many numbers.
